sources: Kuckuck, Kuckuck, ruft's aus dem Wald — Austrian folk melody, text Hoffmann von Fallersleben (1835); public domain
notes: C position (C-G), quarters, halves and quarter rests. Lines: G E, G E, D C D C / D D E F- D, E E F G- E / G E, G E, F E D C. Written out from memory in the simplest form; no network in the build environment, so not compared against an online score. Needs a listen by a person.
